** The Boardroom Special Fade Immune to Shadow Fade Immune to Ice Fire, Divine

Frump's Misfortune is recommended for levels 25 to 45. It is the sixth dungeon in the normal sequence proceeding from Widower's Nest. It is accessible through Frump's Interdungeonal Resort. There are a number of Quests offered.

Loremaster Vraile says "It's true what they say, there is nowhere in the world quite like Frump's Misfortune, but that is just half the story! No one can forget The Frump himself! Talk about someone who has made somethning from nothing. Then turned it into nothing then something about a dozen times over. Not even male pattern baldness could stop this guy! Let's just say that his combover starts at his ankles and leave it at that!"

Besides the usual explore and kill quests, there is a series revolving around Frump's bitter enemy Roh-Zee, a series centering around Frump's good luck charms and also a series revolving around Dungeon Idol. These are a lot of fun.

DUNGEON DETAILS

Level 1

Ruins Layout. Contains: Ice Orok Runts, Ice Orok Scouts, Poison Mutant Pukers, Poison Mutant Unipsychos , Ice Orok AC Repairmen & Ice Orok AC Overseers.

Deathtroit is located off Level 1.

Deathtroit

Snow Forest Layout. Contains: Ice Mutant Pukers, Shadow Fade Lichlords, Shadow Fade Generals, G'Rulksters


Level 2

Catacombs Layout. Contains: Ice Orok Runts, Ice Orok Scouts, Ice Mutant Pukers, Poison Mutant Unipsychos.

Level 3

Catacombs Layout. Contains: Ice Orok Runts, Ice Orok Scouts, Ice Orok Mystics, Poison Mutant Pukers, Poison Mutant Unipsychos, Poison Mutant Pincers, Poison Mutant Twins, and the Soul Patrol.

Cleaveland is located off Level 3.

Cleaveland

Ice Cave Layout. Contains Poison Mutant Pukers, Poison Mutant Unipsychos, Poison Mutant Pincers, G'Rulksters, Shadow Fade Lichlords, Shadow Fade Generals.

Level 4

Catacombs Layout. Contains Contains Ice Orok Runts, Ice Orok Scouts, Ice Orok Mystics, Poison Mutant Pukers, Poison Mutant Unipsychos,Poison Mutant Pincers.

H.E.L.L.A is located off Level 4.

H.E.L.L.A.

Ice Cave Layout. Contains: Ice Mutant Pukers, Ice Mutant Twins, G'Rulksters, Shadow Fade Lichlords, Shadow Fade Generals, Shadow Fade Hatchlings.

Level 5

Cave Layout. Contains: Ice Mutant Hulks, Ice Mutant Pukers, Shadow Fade Lichlords, Shadow Fade Generals.

Karnage's Lot and The Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine are located off Level 5.


Karnage's Lot

Ice Cave Layout. Contains: Divine Whisker Seers, Divine Whisker Venomspitters, Divine Whisker Blademasters, Ice Fade Hatchlings, Ice Fade Banshees. Champions Ancient Sinistrads and Aged Lorgalis. Someplace in Karnage's Lot you will encounter Colonel Carnage, an Ice Fade General Hero who usually drops good purples.

Level 6

Cave Layout. Contains: Ice Mutant Twins, Ice Mutant Pukers, Ice Mutant Hulks, Shadow Fade Hatchlings, Shadow Fade Lichlords and Shadow Fade Generals.

Level 7

Cave Layout. Contains: Ice Mutant Twins, Ice Mutant Pukers, Ice Mutant Hulks, Shadow Fade Hatchlings, Shadow Fade Lichlords and Shadow Fade Generals. Choppe's Shoppe, Je'zzee's Gorage and The Boardroom are located off Level 7

Choppe's Shoppe

Catacombs Layout. Contains: Ice Fade Hatchlings, Ice Fade Banshees, Divine Whisker Blademasters, Divine Whisker Spitters, Divine Whisker Shaman. Somewhere in Choppe's Shoppe you will find Dr. Richard Choppe, a Divine Whisker Blademaster Hero.

Je'zzee's Gorage

Ice Cave Layout. Contains: Ice Fade Hatchling,Ice Fade Skeletons, Ice Fade Mechanics, Ice Fade Banshees, Divine Whisker Venomspitters, Divine Whisker Blademasters. Somewhere you will find Je'zzee Jaymes, an Ice Fade Skeleton Hero.

The Boardroom

Frump, the Boss of Frump's Misfortune

On entering the Boardroom you will go up several flights of stairs. At the top of the last flight is a Fade Generator machine. On either side are barriers. Destroying the machine will lower the first barrier, releasing a large horde of Shadow Fade Banshees, Ice Fade Generals, Ice Fade Hatchlings and maybe some other things. The principal enemy will be Crypolyn Kaptcher, a Hero who appears as a giant bug.

If you dispatch this lot you will open another barrier, where you will encounter a similar group led by GorgeNFloss, another big bug who actually appears as a Boss in his info box.

After passing this lot, you can proceed up to the Boardroom, where you will see several skeletons seated in chairs plus a nondescript little man who is Frump. The skeletons do nothing but you must dispatch Frump to gain access to the portal to The Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

For tips on fighting The Frump, see the Frump Boss Guide.
